label: Late-episode D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), with previous trial rewarded
explanation: Fires only at D2 steps, and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition after a rewarded previous trial (in_rew was 1 at this trial D1). Every activation is in the last ~15 trials of the 100-trial episode (none before trial 80, 77% of steps in trials 90-99) and at low model value (<5.2 for 90% of the mass), so it looks like an end-of-episode signal tied to this one input configuration. Zero activity at D1/GO, after a1, at S1, or after rare transitions. The core conjunction gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.07. Adding ep_trial>=85 gives F1 0.61, and also requiring value<5.5 gives dev F1 0.71 (precision 0.57, recall 0.93, mass recall 0.98). Precision stays incomplete: many matching late-episode steps do not fire. Requiring that the previous trial was also a2->S2 lowered F1. All variables are observable at D2, so no future variables are used.
